items.title: QI Brain session + decision logging
items.detail: Today only implement-worthy features are logged to the Brain (POST /api/log_feature). Wire qi.log_session() per cycle (videos swept, summarized, scored) and qi.log_decision() for notable picks, so the ecosystem has cross-project visibility into what TubeScout is surfacing. integration.brain_base is already configured.

items.title: Reconcile registry vs. live tunnel
items.detail: qi_registry.json still describes QI_TubeScoutTunnel as an ephemeral quick tunnel, but it was migrated 2026-06-18 to the permanent named tunnel tubescout.quiddityinnovations.com. Update the registry services[] entry and exposes_to_ecosystem to match QI_Service_Registry.md.

items.title: Reconcile CLAUDE.md paths
items.detail: CLAUDE.md and api/main.py still import the QI registry from the legacy C:\QI\ECOSYSTEM; the canonical location migrated to C:\QIH\ecosystem on 2026-04-22. Repoint the sys.path.insert and the doc references.

items.title: Run qi_validator on tubescout
items.detail: Run python C:\QIH\ecosystem\qi_validator.py --project tubescout to confirm folder layout, port allocation (8503 API / 7843 UI) and the Module Interface Contract, and fix any drift flagged.

items.title: Drain the transcript backlog
items.detail: 3,824 videos sit transcript_status='pending' while summaries already exist from descriptions. With the IP-block backoff in place, run shared.process in paced batches (or raise transcripts.max_per_run) to upgrade description-fallback cards (1,640 of them) to real transcript-based briefs.

items.title: Score-aware news ordering
items.detail: implement_score is computed for AI/dev videos but the news page orders only by favorite + recency. Surface the highest-signal (highest-scoring) AI/dev briefs first, and show the score/tags on the card for builder triage.

items.title: Smarter dedup (semantic, not token)
items.detail: Dedup is Jaccard over headline tokens — robust but misses paraphrases. Consider embedding headlines (reuse NEXUS/ChromaDB) for semantic clustering, while keeping the conservative false-merge bias.

items.title: Per-channel sweep cadence
items.detail: All channels are swept on the same 07:00/19:00 schedule. High-volume must-reads could sweep more often and dormant channels less, spreading quota and freshness intelligently.

items.title: Harden Discover (partial → live)
items.detail: The recommender works but depends on enough favorites for a taste signal and on NEXUS being up. Add graceful empty-state guidance, cache resolved channels, and make the gemma4 fully-local path the documented default for privacy.

items.title: Interest-weighted briefs
items.detail: interests (AI/Travel/Retirement/DOAC) steer Discover; extend them to weight the news feed itself — pin briefs that match stated interests higher, not just by topic chip.

items.title: Watch-later / read state
items.detail: Let the owner mark a brief read or save-for-later so the feed reflects what's already been triaged across the 07:00/19:00 windows.

items.title: Evaluate Whisper fallback at scale
items.detail: Whisper fallback is built and verified but off by default (downloads audio). Benchmark cost/quality on the ~38 caption-less videos and decide whether to enable it selectively for favorites/must-reads only.

items.title: Multi-language brief output
items.detail: Transcripts are fetched in en/pt/es/ja/fr but briefs are always English. Offer pt-BR briefs (the owner is Brazilian) by passing the target language into the NEXUS summary prompt.

items.title: Enforce the write token publicly
items.detail: The write-guard middleware exists but writes are open when TUBESCOUT_PAGE_TOKEN is unset. Set the token in secrets for the public tunnel so the page stays read-only to visitors while the owner can still tune it.

items.title: DB growth + retention
items.detail: videos/summaries are at ~4,000 rows and the DB file is ~12 MB. Add a retention/archival policy for old videos and a periodic VACUUM as the twice-daily sweep keeps accumulating.

items.title: Expand smoke coverage
items.detail: tests/test_smoke.py checks the live contract endpoints. Add offline unit tests for organizer.classify(), dedup._jaccard()/run_dedup(), and summarize._parse() so pipeline logic is covered without a running service.
